name: continue

description: Internal architecture-only Stop hook

name: reindex
description: Index the codebase and convert to SQLite

name: augment-sources
description: Add source files skipped by upstream SCIP indexers to the SQLite documents table

description: Add compiler-resolved Vue SFC references to the SQLite index using Volar

name: stats
description: Show index statistics

name: files
description: Find current project files matching a path pattern

name: session
description: Show evidence already delivered in this agent exploration session

name: inspect
description: Batch related searches, symbols, and source locations into one deduplicated source packet

name: search
description: Count current project text matches and preview a bounded, recoverable identity and source manifest

name: methods
description: List methods of one exactly resolved class; ambiguity and missing targets fail explicitly

name: refs
description: Find all files referencing a symbol

name: evidence
description: Traverse selected typed relationships around exact referents; recover source separately when needed

name: deps
description: Files this file depends on (internal)

name: rdeps
description: Files that depend on this file/module

name: system
description: One-hop module summary: matched files, documented symbols, and file reference dependencies

name: surface
description: What symbols consumers actually use from this module

name: dead
description: Find repository-dead code, file-internal symbols, and implicit-usage signals

name: hotspots
description: Rank symbols by referencing chunks, or incoming evidence rows when SCIP mentions are unavailable

name: imports
description: What symbols does this file import?

name: imported-by
description: Which files import this symbol?

name: unused-imports
description: Find imports not referenced in the same file

name: outline
description: Tree view of symbols in a file, with line ranges

name: members
description: All children of a symbol (methods, fields, nested types)

name: fan-in
description: Count files referencing an exact symbol; top JSON rows include exact symbol identity

name: fan-out
description: How many external symbols a file uses (or top fan-out across codebase)

name: coupling
description: Count shared-symbol coupling between two files, or rank file pairs by that metric

name: cycles
description: Find every cyclic file-dependency component and show one deterministic witness for each

name: architecture
description: Evaluate project-owned architectural boundaries and dependency rules

name: bottlenecks
description: Rank coordination hubs by incoming evidence files × outgoing cross-file callable targets

name: by-kind
description: Find symbols by SCIP kind (class, interface, enum, function, etc.)

name: kind-counts
description: Histogram of symbol kinds in the codebase

name: dependency-depth
description: Find longest paths through the SCC-condensed file dependency graph

name: hierarchy
description: Show indexed lexical owners of a symbol (method → class → module)

name: entrypoints
description: Find callables where control may enter from outside the indexed call graph

name: entry-map
description: Map the complete indexed call graph from one detected entry point, collapsed by file

name: call-graph
description: Show static may-call edges with exact/candidate evidence and explicit blind spots

description: Find heuristic function similarity candidates from callee fingerprints

name: similar-files
description: Find heuristic similar-file candidates from dependency profiles

description: Find heuristic duplicated React component structure candidates from JSX tags, props, events, and bindings

name: react-hook-candidates
description: Find heuristic React hook extraction candidates from shared state, effects, requests, and handlers

name: react-large-component-pressure
description: Find heuristic large React component pressure candidates from component lines, JSX structure, and hook behavior

name: vue-component-duplicates
description: Find heuristic duplicated Vue component structure candidates from template tags, bindings, slots, and directives

name: vue-composable-candidates
description: Find heuristic Vue composable extraction candidates from shared state, effects, requests, and template bindings

name: vue-large-view-pressure
description: Find heuristic large Vue view pressure candidates from template, script, style, and external script line counts

name: locality-candidates
description: Find directory-locality and ancestry candidates from consumer ownership

name: affected
description: Conservative reverse caller/reference closure of symbols that may be impacted by a change

name: change-surface
description: Pre-change briefing: consumers, published API, operational roots, and explained change risk

name: cleanup-plan
description: Ordered, batched deletion plan: graph-fact dead code plus the cascade candidates it unlocks

name: co-change
description: Files that change together in git history without a dependency edge — hidden coupling candidates

name: recent-duplicates
description: Similarity candidates in recently added files, oriented by file age; function creation time is not known

name: doc-drift
description: Stale-doc candidates: code the doc references or co-changed with kept changing after the doc stopped

name: unused-params
description: Speculative-generality candidates: trailing parameters no body ever uses (TS/JS)

name: incomplete-migration
description: Partially-completed extraction candidates: new helpers in the diff wired into some sites while similar un-migrated sites remain

name: context
description: Compiler-backed context for a symbol, file, or module

name: drift
description: Detect drift candidates: unused imports and declared architecture violations; pass --architecture for boundary context

name: passthrough-candidates
description: Find heuristic passthrough candidates that forward to one callee

name: slice-cohesion
description: Find low-cohesion candidates from backward slices: outputs whose statements never meet are separate local computations

name: code
description: Read exact definitions, line ranges, or file export surfaces

name: complexity
description: Per-symbol complexity: branches, cyclomatic estimate, fan-in/out, callees

name: dependence-slice
description: Slice one variable occurrence through function-local value and control dependencies

name: redundant-reexports
description: Find re-export candidates with no resolved local source imports or re-exports; external use is unknown

name: duplicate-bodies
description: Find exact duplicate small-body candidates across files

name: twin-drift
description: Twin drift candidates: same-name (or near-name) functions across files with diverged bodies

name: not-implemented
description: Placeholder candidates with observed consumer or entry-surface evidence: throw-stub, TODO plus default return, or empty body

name: decorative-checkers
description: Checker candidates lacking detected explicit failure syntax; implicit exceptions and property effects are not proved absent

name: test-quality
description: Test-quality candidates: assertion-free it/test bodies, a skipped-test ledger with git-blame age, and mock-echo tests that assert the same literal they stubbed into a mock

name: similar-signatures
description: Group functions by normalized signature text; shared type identity or responsibility is not established

description: Internal diff-impact batch worker

name: __health-phase
description: Internal health phase worker

name: __health-semantic-prewarm
description: Internal health semantic prewarm worker

description: Find concrete TS/JS complexity, duplication, and dependency issues without an index

description: Install core exploration skills into Claude Code, Codex, and shared agent roots

description: Check whether scip-query and the detected language indexers are runnable

description: Report which mapping and analysis capabilities are available in this project

description: Validate .scipquery.json, structured suppressions, architecture, and coupling groups

description: Diagnose configuration, index freshness, dependencies, and project capabilities

description: Write concise scip-query mapping and cleanup guidance to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

description: Remove selected scip-query-owned skills or project guidance

description: Watch in the foreground or manage the project refresh service

name: status
description: Show index status for this project
